description.value: The Monkey Tree Pub is a spacious Victoria neighbourhood pub that has been a community gathering place since 1986, founded by BC hospitality icon Gordon Card on a commitment to craft food and drink. The kitchen uses fresh, hand-cut ingredients and runs rotating seasonal specials alongside pub classics, while the bar offers a daily happy hour and rotating beer and cocktail selections. The venue also operates an on-site liquor store and accepts takeout orders by phone.
